title.zh: 央行调一个利率，为什么所有东西的价格都跟着动
title.en: Why One Central-Bank Rate Moves the Price of Everything

desc.zh: 从“明天的钱今天值多少”出发，一步步走到债券、收益率曲线、央行的准备金、泰勒规则、新凯恩斯模型、股票房价汇率、量化宽松和政府债务，最后是 2026 年底各大央行所处的位置与争论。十三个可以拖动的模型，八张示意图。
desc.en: Starting from “what tomorrow's money is worth today,” the essay walks through bonds, the yield curve, central-bank reserves, the Taylor rule, the New Keynesian model, stocks, houses, exchange rates, quantitative easing and government debt, and ends with where the major central banks stand at the end of 2026 and the debates still going on. Thirteen models you can drag, eight static diagrams.
